requirements.title: Exceptional floating-point classes are subnormal, infinity, and NaN
requirements.definition: ISO/IEC 60559 specifies subnormal values as very small values with reduced precision, infinities as values created by overflow or division by zero, and NaNs as undefined values or values created by invalid operations.

pending.subnormal-class-definition: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_SUBNORMAL(0.0); supported branch forms s=TINY(0.0)*0.5, invokes IEEE_CLASS only after the datatype guard, and asserts IEEE_CLASS(s)==IEEE_POSITIVE_SUBNORMAL; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.infinity-class-definition: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_INF(0.0); supported branch obtains IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_POSITIVE_INF), invokes IEEE_CLASS only after the datatype guard, and asserts IEEE_CLASS reports IEEE_POSITIVE_INF; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.nan-class-definition: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(0.0); supported branch obtains IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_QUIET_NAN), invokes IEEE_IS_NAN only after the datatype guard, and asserts IEEE_IS_NAN is true; unsupported branch records skip.

requirements.title: A normal number is outside the exceptional classes
requirements.definition: A value outside the subnormal, infinity, and NaN classes is called a normal number.

requirements.title: Exceptional-value inquiry and generation procedures are provided
requirements.definition: IEEE_IS_FINITE, IEEE_IS_NAN, IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE, and IEEE_IS_NORMAL test value properties; IEEE_VALUE generates IEEE numbers of any class; IEEE_SUPPORT_SUBNORMAL, IEEE_SUPPORT_INF, and IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN inquire availability for a real kind.

pending.ieee-is-finite-provided: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0); supported branch asserts IEEE_IS_FINITE(1.0) is true, and a nested IEEE_SUPPORT_INF(0.0) branch asserts IEEE_IS_FINITE(IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_POSITIVE_INF)) is false; unsupported datatype branch records skip.
pending.ieee-is-nan-provided: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(0.0); supported branch asserts IEEE_IS_NAN(IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_QUIET_NAN)) is true and IEEE_IS_NAN(1.0) is false; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.ieee-is-negative-provided: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0); supported branch asserts IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(-1.0) is true and IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(1.0) is false; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.ieee-is-normal-provided: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0); supported branch asserts IEEE_IS_NORMAL(1.0) is true and IEEE_IS_NORMAL(0.0) is false; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.ieee-value-provided: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0), then nested IEEE_SUPPORT_INF(0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(0.0) branches generate positive infinity and quiet NaN with IEEE_VALUE and observe them through IEEE_CLASS or IEEE_IS_NAN only after the datatype guard; unsupported branches record skip.
pending.exceptional-support-inquiries-provided: Compile-time plan: call IEEE_SUPPORT_SUBNORMAL, IEEE_SUPPORT_INF, and IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN with 0.0 and with no actual X, assert each result has type logical and scalar rank.

accounting.rationale: Defines normal number by exclusion from exceptional classes.

review_rationale: Source registration for 17.6-17.10, 17.11, 17.11.1 and 17.11.2: halting, floating-point modes and status, exceptional values, IEEE arithmetic, the procedure summary and general rules, and IEEE_CLASS (batch214). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across three rounds; every IEEE effect is a guarded branch plan keyed to its own support inquiry, with exact 60559 results for infinity and subnormal operands. Source accounting only.
